description: This file defines the functionality for creating a comment on an article within the application. It includes request validation, handling logic to associate a new comment with an article and the current user, and returns the created comment encapsulated in an envelope.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Contains nested records, validator, and handler to process creating comments on articles.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to create a comment, validating article existence, associating author and comment data, and saving changes to the database.
